visual.general_description: Four-panel histopathology figure (panels A to D) of liver biopsy tissue with trichrome, H&E, CK7 immunohistochemical and rhodanine stains.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a wide low-power trichrome-type section with a 500 µm scale bar; panels B, C and D below show a pink-purple stained section, a pale blue section with brown-stained foci, and a high-power field with brown-red granules marked by two yellow arrows. Each panel has its letter printed at the upper left.

panels.general_description: Low-power stained liver tissue section with a printed scale bar.
panels.detailed_description: Panel letter A at the upper left with a scale bar printed as 500 µm. An elongated tissue fragment shows rounded dark red-maroon areas separated by broad blue-stained bands that link the red areas, with small white vascular or open spaces within the blue bands. The tissue edge is irregular and the surrounding background is white.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Blue and red-maroon trichrome-type staining of an elongated tissue fragment with a printed scale bar
